name.text: W03_Q17: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following wicked acts were committed by Hophni and Phinehas at the sanctuary in Shiloh? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Hophni and Phinehas defiled the sacrifices, used the three-pronged fleshhook with threats of violence, and committed sexual immorality at the Tabernacle entrance (1 Samuel 2:13-17, 22).

name.text: W03_Q18: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Which of the following catastrophic events occurred on the single day of the Battle of Aphek? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: All four events occurred on that fateful day: 30,000 soldiers died, the Ark was captured, Hophni and Phinehas died, and Eli collapsed and died upon hearing the news (1 Samuel 4:10-18).

name.text: W03_Q19: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Match each person with their role in the tragic account of Eli's house:

generalfeedback.text: Eli was the passive father/priest; his sons were corrupt; Samuel received the prophetic revelation; and Phinehas' wife died naming Ichabod.

name.text: W03_Q20: Christian Religious Studies JSS1 Assessment

questiontext.text: Match each Hebrew or biblical term with its meaning:

generalfeedback.text: Shiloh was the worship center; Aphek was the battlefield; fleshhook was the tool used to take meat; and Ichabod means "the glory has departed."
